description: Transcribes one audio or video file the user owns or may use into timestamped text with SRT and VTT captions. Best for: "transcribe this podcast episode", "make subtitles for my video", "what is said in this file". Returns: language, length, timestamped segments, SRT and VTT (trim with include), transcript_id, expires_at (kept 24 hours, the media is never kept), minutes left today, and library_id when the caller has no user id. Input tips: give file (an upload) or url (a public TikTok, Instagram or other social video, or a direct media link), not both. Set confirm_rights true only after the user says they own the recording or have the rights (a public social video needs none); otherwise ask. Pass library_id from an earlier answer to keep transcripts in one library. Not for: YouTube (call get_transcript), private videos, over 15 MB or 15 minutes, whole channels. Formats: mp3, m4a, mp4, wav, ogg, flac, webm. A daily allowance of minutes applies per user and in total.

confirm_rights.description: true, and only after the user has said they own this recording or have the rights to transcribe it. false is refused with rights_not_confirmed (ask the user first), except for a link to a public video on a social platform, which needs no statement.

file.description: An audio or video file the user uploaded to the chat (ChatGPT fills this in). Give this or url, not both.

download_url.description: Temporary link to the uploaded file.

file_name.description: Name of the file, such as episode-4.mp3. Used as the title when title is left out.

mime_type.description: Media type of the file, such as audio/mpeg or video/mp4.

include.description: What to return besides the summary (default all three): timestamped segments, SRT captions, VTT captions.

language.description: Spoken language as an ISO 639-1 code such as en or fr. Leave out to detect it.

library_id.description: Leave out on the first transcription. Pass the library_id from an earlier transcribe_media answer, such as lib_9b6a98861ea4f54bff8f5cf1, to add this transcript to that same library, so search_transcripts finds both together.

title.description: Name to show for the transcript (default: the file name).

url.description: Link to a public video on TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, X, Vimeo or another social platform (its audio is read and transcribed), or a direct link to an audio or video file, such as https://example.com/talk.mp3. Give this or file, not both. For a YouTube link call get_transcript instead.

name: transcribe_media

as_of.description: The UTC day of the answer, such as 2026-10-10.

covered_seconds.description: Seconds of audio transcribed when partial is true.

duration_seconds.description: Length of the recording, in whole seconds.

expires_at.description: When the transcript is deleted, as an ISO 8601 UTC time.

language.description: Spoken language as an ISO 639-1 code, such as en.

library_id.description: A string when the caller has no ChatGPT user id: pass it as library_id to the other tools and to later transcribe_media calls. null otherwise.

partial.description: True when only the first covered_seconds of a longer recording were transcribed within the 30-second interactive call budget.

segments.description: Timestamped stretches of speech (when include has segments).

end.description: End, in seconds from the beginning of the recording.

start.description: Start, in seconds from the beginning of the recording.

text.description: The words spoken in this stretch.

host.description: Host the file was read from; null for an upload.

kind.description: upload for a file from the chat, url for a link.

srt.description: SRT captions with numbered cues (when include has srt).

status.description: ok: the file was transcribed. A refused call returns no object, only an error text such as "transcript_not_found: ..." that says what to do next.

title.description: The title given, or the file name.

transcript_id.description: Id of a saved transcript, for suggest_clips and translate_subtitles.

charged_seconds.description: Audio seconds this call used from today's allowance.

seconds_left_today.description: Audio seconds the caller can still transcribe today (UTC).

title: Transcribe a recording into text and captions
